lines: Deewana banana hai to deewana bana de
Warna kahin taqdeer tamasha na bana de
couplets.en: If you mean to drive me mad, do so before fate makes a spectacle of me.

lines: Ai dekhne waalo, mujhe hans hans ke na dekho
couplets.en: You who stand watching, do not laugh at me.

lines: Tumko bhi mohabbat kahin mujh sa na bana de
couplets.en: Love may yet make you as I am.

lines: Main dhoondh raha hoon, meri woh shama kahan hai?
couplets.en: Where is that flame I keep looking for?

lines: Jo bazm ki har cheez ko parwana bana de
couplets.en: Where is that flame of mine that would turn everything in the room into a moth?

lines: Aakhir koi soorat bhi to ho khaana-e-dil ki
Kaaba nahin banta hai to but-khaana bana de
couplets.en: The heart must take some shape, and if it cannot be a Kaaba, make it a temple of idols.

lines: Behzad, har ik gaam pe ik sajda-e-masti
Har zarre ko sang-e-dar-e-jaanana bana de
couplets.en: Behzad, bow in rapture at every step and make each grain of dust the stone at the beloved's threshold.

lines: Har zarre ko sang-e-dar-e-jaanana bana de
couplets.en: Make every grain of dust the stone at the beloved's threshold.
